entry.title: Crypto market report: week to November 22, 2026
entry.summary: In the seven days to November 22, 2026, Bitcoin fell 6.2% and Ethereum fell 6.0%. Of the 110 coins tracked here (stablecoins excluded), 6 rose and 104 fell; the median coin fell 8.0%. The best performer was Mog Coin, which rose 4.7%, and the worst was Sky, which fell 23.3%. By sector median, DePIN did best (-5.48%) and Gaming did worst (-12.45%). Among coins with a full year of data, none closed at a new 52-week high and 55 coins at a new 52-week low.
